questions: Does commit rerank depth 100 or 200 improve over 50?

models.query_instruction:
Instruct: Given a developer question or a description of behaviour, retrieve the code that implements it
Query:

retrieval.rerank_instruction: Given a bug report, judge whether this commit's changes fix the reported bug

depth.scoring: one production 200-pair call per query per judge; all depth arms reuse its probabilities
depth.tie_order: probability descending, original fused rank ascending
depth.historical: v2 retrieval_k=50 rerank depth=50 is a separate historical control, not the prefix-50 baseline

weight.selection: pooled dev questions only; test is descriptive, never selects
weight.conditional: if selected !=0.3, run fresh 8B depth50 with selected and 0.3, paired test comparison; no automatic default changes

cohorts.source_path: any old/new gold path outside docs/doc/documentation directories, rst/md/txt suffixes and changes/changelog/history/news basename prefixes; localization proxy includes tests/configs; not independent bug-fix labels

query_budgets.rerank: first 2000 characters, then pair tokenizer max 2048 tokens
query_budgets.interpretation: BM25_2000 is a character-budget sensitivity check, not a matched-token neural comparison

timing.order: first 60 from deterministic round-robin sorted test IDs across sorted repo stems; frozen IDs in cohorts.json
timing.depth_order: rotate depth order by question index plus repetition
timing.warmup: one unmeasured production call at each depth per repo
timing.label: warm A100 experiment timing, per-repo p50/p95 and ratios only; never average repository percentiles; shared quality prefix scores do not measure depth latency

not_measured: similar past fix usefulness for a new bug
no_tuning: no test-driven selection; original labels reused after inspection, not a fresh holdout; 4B is secondary; exploratory pointwise group CIs without multiplicity adjustment
